definitions.explanation: The act of adjusting or moderating something; adding and subtracting.
The condition or state of something; how something is.
One's physical condition, especially when unwell.

examples.japanese: {塩|しお}{加減|かげん}がちょうどいい。
examples.english: The amount of salt is just right.

examples.japanese: いい{加減|かげん}にして!
examples.english: Cut it out! / Give it a rest!

notes:
{加減|かげん} has multiple related meanings around adjustment and condition.

SENSE 1 - ADJUSTMENT:
- 〜を{加減|かげん}する (to adjust ~)
- {加減|かげん}{乗除|じょうじょ} (the four arithmetic operations)

SENSE 2 - DEGREE:
- {塩|しお}{加減|かげん} (amount of salt)
- {湯|ゆ}{加減|かげん} (water temperature)
- いい{加減|かげん} (moderate; also: irresponsible)

SENSE 3 - HEALTH:
- {加減|かげん}が{悪|わる}い (not feeling well)
- お{加減|かげん}はいかがですか (How are you feeling?)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- いい{加減|かげん}にしろ (Cut it out!)
- いい{加減|かげん}な (half-hearted, irresponsible)
